bar_reachability.note: These are development values. They fix what a bar can reach; they are not the holdout result and no bar may be set after the holdout is read.

oscillating_threshold.note: min_event_size 1 is the only setting that permits sustained alternation

platform.limitation: Only one platform is available in this checkout. The reduction contract removes the usual cross-platform hazard by routing every reduction through math.fsum instead of BLAS, but a second platform has not been executed and the cross-platform claim is not made.

determinism.reduction_contract: element-wise float32 arithmetic with every reduction computed by math.fsum over float64 products, so no BLAS reassociation, thread count, or machine can change a bit

buckets.annotated: first episode after an annotated domain change inside a session
buckets.session_start: first episode of a session, where the hard predicate fires

embedding.call_shape: solo (one text per call), as pinned by the source run

episode_unit.identity: sha256 over session token, stream position, and canonical pair JSON

holdout_structure.note: counts and identity only; no threshold is selected from these

context.claim: normalize(rho * previous context + (1 - rho) * current vector)

drift.claim: 1 - cosine between the current vector and the previous prototype

episode.claim: one stored user-plus-assistant exchange with one pinned vector

event.claim: every episode belongs to exactly one event, in append order

name_checks.falsifiable_identity: At a fixed configuration the former opens a new event at episode t if and only if at least one of the three recorded causal predicates is true: the session token changed, the open event already holds min_event_size members and 1 - cosine(x_t, p_(t-1)) >= drift_threshold, or the open event already holds max_event_size members. It reads no text, no future episode, no answer key, and no annotation.

forced_boundary.claim: fires exactly when the open event already holds max_event_size members

prototype.claim: normalized arithmetic mean of the open event's member vectors

session.claim: hard boundaries fire on exactly the session changes and nowhere else

rho_sweep.selection_rule: highest development context AUC; rho does not enter the boundary rule, so this choice cannot move a boundary or a G4 result

scope: Part 1 exploration. No parameter is selected on the holdout split and no gate bar is evaluated here.

grid.rho_note: rho does not enter the boundary rule; it only shapes the context vector
